column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 1
Good day, Onii-san.
Oh, welcome!
The next day, Ayase has come over again.
We never got further in the 'discussion' because Kirino was playing her 【H-Games】, so we're continuing today..
Sorry, but it seems Kirino went out earlier.
...Oh, I see.
Mind waiting in the living room?
You should have a long and nice chat with Kirino once she gets back.
Okay. But before that...
I forgot to ask you something yesterday, so would you mind if I ask now?
...Something you forgot to ask me?
Why does Kirino like those... 【H-Games】?
Saying it's because of your 'bond of love'... is a lie, isn't it, Onii-san?
Well, yeah.
If it were true, it'd be awful.
...Actually, I don't really know.
I've asked Kirino about it before, but...
I-I... don't even know that myself.
You don't know? Come on, how can you not know it yourself?
I-It can't be helped! ...I really don't know... Before I knew it, I just started liking them...
That's what she said.
Do you think she's telling the truth?
Eh? I don't see why she would lie in that situation.
...I see.
I can tell from her expression that she ain't satisfied with that.
Um... Onii-san.
I want... to properly understand Kirino's hobby.
Okay.
Would you... help me?
That's an unexpected request.
You're still pretty much against Kirino's hobby, right?
Yes... But I would like to try overcoming it.
...Overcoming it, huh...
...I think that'll be hard.
...Extraordinarily hard.
Um...
Hmm...
I... want to find common topics I can share with Kirino.
I think... it's because I don't know anything about what Kirino loves that I'm feeling anxious.
She didn't seem to be lying.
Still, it didn't seem like she was telling me the whole story.
Could what she's really worrying about be...
It's like that, is it?
Well, whatever.
Regardless, I've already decided what I'm going to do.
...Um... Onii-san?
Alright. 【Leave it to me】.
Ah, yes!
Ayase, let's play this game together.
...I-Is that...
Yeah, it's the game Kirino was playing yesterday.
I-I-Isn't that one of those 【H-Games】?!
It is.
I knew it! What are you thinking, you pervert?! I-I'll report you!
Oh? I thought you wanted to overcome it.
Kuh...
I did say that, but even so...
No need to be embarrassed, I'll be watching right beside you.
That makes it even more embarrassing!
Want to find another way then? I thought it might be a bit too much for you.
Ayase lowered her head and frustratingly bit her lips.
I guess I might've looked the same way when Kirino forced me to start playing these 【H-Games】.
...It can't be helped then.
We'll have to go with the all-ages edition.
You should have taken that one out right away if you had it!
Ayase sounded just like I did back then.
You don't understand at all.
While both the all-ages edition and the standard one have the same title, the contents are different.
Hey Kirino, I'm using your words here.
What I was holding was Sis×Sis (all-ages edition).
It's the prequel to Sis×Sis Moushouden, which Kirino was playing yesterday.
I remember Kirino's words...
The all-ages edition of Sis×Sis is out! I bought it right away!
...Isn't it basically the same as the other version?
They added the scenario for a whole new heroine, Asahi-chan!
Didn't you say "just adding a heroine isn't enough"?
This and that are completely unrelated.
I'll lend it to you after I complete it, so you'd better play it!
And that's what she said.
Since there are no H-scenes, it's perfect entry-level material for Ayase to understand Kirino's hobby.
Alright, let's get to it!
...You seem to be enjoying yourself.
That's not true... I'm starting it up, ready?
Y-Yes... I've prepared myself. This is really embarrassing though...
Ayase's really cute when she's embarrassed.
...My heart skipped a beat.
L-Let's start.
